intent: Export the action of Aut_Z12_v1 on the typed phase carrier Phase_12_v1, making the generator/orientation ambiguity explicit as a finite gauge symmetry.

meaning.note: This action corresponds to reindexing the phase generator by a unit u; it is the typed representation of the non-uniqueness of Z_12 phase embeddings.

hard_limits: Does not select a canonical embedding Z_12_v1 -> Phase_12_v1.
Does not export any Berry/holonomy or theta construction.
Does not claim QW-2191 discharge nor ToE closure.
